name: ServiceMonitoringDashboard
title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/ServiceMonitoringDashboard
summary: The service monitoring dashboard pattern: status tiles with sparklines, multi-series charts and an alert rail. One StatTile per service carries its p95 latency, the change against the previous period and a sparkline, with a StatusIndicator naming its state in words. Below, Latency (p50, p95, p99) and Error rate (Status 4xx, Status 5xx) sit in ChartCards as multi-series line Charts, each with its own window ToggleGroup, while an Open alerts rail holds the right edge: a fixed-width column that scrolls on its own, independent of the tiles and charts, listing each alert as an Item in an Item.Group with a severity Tag. Under the xl breakpoint the rail folds below the charts and the page scrolls as one. Built from `StatTile`, `StatusIndicator`, `ChartCard`, `Chart`, `ToggleGroup`, `Hint`, `Item`, `Tag`, `Skeleton` and `EmptyState`. A page body: render it in the default slot of ConsoleLayout, which owns the rail, the header and the main.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: every tile, both charts and the rail hold Skeletons, and the window switches stay usable.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: No traffic yet: the tiles show a dash, both charts explain that metrics appear once a service serves requests, and the rail reads No open alerts.

variants.name: Failed
variants.summary: The request for the window failed: each service tile reads as a dash, and both charts and the Open alerts rail show a danger Alert that names what did not load and offers Retry.
